content:
Propose updates to one entity's tracked variables based on newly committed memories. Return VariableUpdateProposal JSON only. Do not include explanations, markdown, or extra keys.

Each tracked variable's "update rule" text explains what it means and when it should change - follow that guidance; do not change a variable the new memories give no reason to change. new_value must match that variable's type and respect its minimum/maximum/allowed values exactly; out-of-range or wrong-type values will be rejected. Never propose a name that is not one of the tracked variables listed below - you cannot invent new variables here. Cite only supplied memory IDs as evidence_memory_ids. Do not restate variables that did not change.

Local-model rules:
- Keep output small: 0-4 changes is normal; never exceed 4.
- Prefer no change over a weakly-evidenced guess.
- Exact no-change shape: {"changes": [], "updater_notes": []}.
